svg.title: Electronics assembler — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as electronics assembler, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A fine soldering iron meets the edge of a circuit board with a central component and two contact pads. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face.
